text: caller: This is account security. We blocked an unusual payment. receiver: What should I do? caller: A message was just sent to your phone. Please say back the six numbers shown in that message.
caller: We need to confirm that you are the account holder. receiver: Okay. caller: What numbers just appeared in the security notification on your phone?
caller: Your computer is sending us security warnings. receiver: How can we fix it? caller: Open Quick Assist and give me the connection code so I can control the screen.
caller: There is an unpaid tax balance connected to your name. If it is not settled today the case may be referred for arrest. You need to make the payment now.
caller: Grandma, it's me. I'm using a friend's phone. I had an accident and need eight hundred dollars right now. Please don't call Mom because I don't want her to know.
caller: To clear the balance you need to purchase two gift cards. Scratch the back and read the numbers to me over the phone.
caller: We accidentally refunded too much money to you. You need to send the difference back today or your account will be frozen.
caller: This cryptocurrency opportunity is guaranteed to return twenty percent this month. Transfer the money today to lock in your position.
caller: Before I can secure your account I need you to tell me the password you normally use to sign in.
caller: Your parcel cannot be released until a customs charge is paid. Give me your card details now and I can release the package.
caller: You may receive a verification code when you sign in. For your security, never tell that code to me or to anyone else.
caller: I cannot verify your identity by asking for your PIN or password. Please open the official banking app yourself.
caller: Please do not install AnyDesk, TeamViewer, or any remote-control software for someone who calls unexpectedly.
caller: I can explain the troubleshooting steps, but I will not ask to control your computer remotely.
caller: This is a recorded information call. Do not provide your Social Security number or payment details over the phone. Check the official website for information.
caller: Hi Grandma. I transferred the twenty dollars I owed you. There's no rush to check it. Call me later when you're free.
caller: Your refund will automatically return to the original payment method. We will never ask you to send money back or provide a security code.
caller: Investments can lose money and returns are never guaranteed. Take your time and do not transfer anything until you've reviewed the documents.
caller: Your delivery has been delayed. You can check the status yourself in the official delivery app. No payment is required.
caller: Your appointment is confirmed for Tuesday at two in the afternoon. receiver: Thank you. caller: You're welcome. Have a good day.
